messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 autopage -> eng-sre on-call: prometheus alert fired: `prometheus_scrape_failures_total{job=\"scrape-proxy\"}` spike in eu-west-1, 5xx responses from target exporters. Alert sig: high_rate. link: https://grafana.internal/r/alerts/5533334444

pagerbot: PagerDuty incident INC-2026 triggered (sev: P1) — assigned to @maria. PD: https://pd.redwood/INC-2026

adeel: looking. pulling up scrape dashboard + kafka lag.

maria: acked :raised_hand: i'm the oncall. starting triage. first glance: scrape failures across multiple jobs in eu-west, not global. no infra deploys in last 2h.

jess: seeing 503/504 from `scrape-proxy` in the logs, also `connection reset` to node_exporter. any recent cert rotations?

maria: no cert rotations scheduled. hitting exporter endpoints directly returns 200 for a few hosts. suggests proxy layer or downstream network.

incident-bot: automated metric check: log-ingest-consumer-lag=235k (threshold 50k), kafka-partition-stalls=14, scrape-proxy-5xx-rate=18%. details: https://metrics.redwood/series?m=5533334444

kai: FYI we had a noisy node restart group in eu-west-1 last night but health looked fine this morning. could be correlated to spike.

maria: running a targeted Prom query to enumerate failing targets:
```
up{job=~".*node_exporter.*", region="eu-west-1"} == 0
```
returns ~120 missing targets (norm ~2).

adeel: if proxy is overloaded we can scale it fast. proposal: `kubectl scale deploy/scrape-proxy -n infra --replicas=8` (was 3). also consider temporary route to eu-west-2.

maria: executing scale now:
```
kubectl scale deploy/scrape-proxy -n infra --replicas=8
```
Scaling...

incident-bot: deploy/scale event recorded by deploy-bot. scrape-proxy replicas increasing to 8.

maria: scaled to 8 :thumbsup: watching metrics. scrape 5xx% dropping from 18% -> 6% in 90s. kafka lag still high though.

jess: can you paste an example of the 5xx log lines?

maria: sample from scrape-proxy logs:
```
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z error proxy: upstream return 502 for target=10.12.7.34:9100 path=/metrics err="read tcp 10.12.7.34:9100: i/o timeout"
```
points to intermittent network timeouts to exporters.

adeel: for kafka/backpressure i'd throttle retention flush? also kicking an additional consumer group would help backfill. quick command I'm going to try: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-1:9092 --execute --group log-ingest-consumer --reset-offsets --to-latest --all-topics` (will coordinate).

incident-bot: automated re-eval: scrape errors down to 6.2% after scale. log-ingest-consumer-lag=198k (was 235k).

jess: any direct customer impact? alerts from downstream services?

maria: quick check of customer-facing alerts: 3 customers reported delayed logs via support (tickets #5481, #5483, #5489). severity: delay only, no data loss reported. ingestion tail latency spikes visible in the last 30m. marking partial impact.

adeel: starting a temporary route override for high-priority exporters: `rbac route set region=eu-west fallback=eu-central` (will avoid hitting overloaded scrape-proxy nodes).

maria: route override applied for 10% of traffic as a canary. monitoring tail. backlog decreasing to 120k. good signal.

pagerbot: PD update: INC-2026 acknowledged by maria. escalation paused.

jess: recommended follow-ups: 1) postmortem to track root cause (proxy/network). 2) adjust scrape alert threshold to add short cooldown so we avoid autopage for brief spikes. 3) ops runbook: autoscale scrape-proxy earlier.

maria: agree. i'll open a postmortem and a follow-up ticket for alerts + autoscale rule. linking notes here when done.

kai: will watch infra for any network flapping. happy to assist if backlog climbs.

maria: closing PD loop for now — suppressing pages. will re-open if lag >200k or 5xx >12% for >5m. tagging @ops for handoff if that happens. thanks team :heart:
